1.title: 'Our parents were crossing the border an hour before the flood hit'
1.summary: Authorities say more than 1,300 people are missing, including dozens of Americans and Canadians, as families await word on loved ones thought to be caught in the Nepal flash floods.

2.title: LA Mayor Karen Bass Eases Street Vending Crackdown After Debate
2.summary: Mayor Karen Bass had compared the ubiquitous purveyors of street food with homeless encampments. Her opponent, Nithya Raman, said vendors should be brought into the system.

3.title: Lake Ontario Didn’t Ask for Trump to Rename It
3.summary: There is a U.S.-led war in the Middle East and the midterm elections on the horizon, but President Trump’s latest priority seems to be “Making The Great Lakes Even Greater.”

4.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Search for Missing and Stranded Under Threat of More Floods
4.summary: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet, and more than 1,400 people are missing. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.

5.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
5.summary: Trump's order comes after the trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed late last week.

6.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
6.summary: Hundreds have died or are missing in Wednesday's flooding and landslides on the border of Nepal and Tibet.
